final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.healtheval, step1.record_count, 1.0 * step1.record_count / step2.total_count AS share FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.total_count IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM step3) SELECT AVG(step3.record_count), AVG(step3.share), AVG(step3.share - step4.mean_share) FROM step3 CROSS JOIN step4 WHERE step4.mean_share IS NOT NULL AND step3.share > step4.mean_share
